items.title: 东方茶商业海报设计
items.prompt:
输出一张 4:5 竖版商业海报，不要拼贴，不要多宫格。使用原创虚构品牌，不得模仿现有品牌的包装、标志或广告。文字仅限提示词中明确列出的品牌名、主标题和品类；不得添加价格、奖项、参数、日期、产地或宣传语。画面完成度须达到可供创意总监审核的标准：结构写实、材质可信、排版清晰、无水印。

主题：东方茶品鉴样品。原创品牌“岚虚”，产品“岩茶”（Yancha），主标题“山田入盏”。

一张暖白色宣纸长卷自底部向上折叠为三折高度不一的页面，形似抽象山脊，同时保留真实纸张的厚度、纤维与折痕。最底层放置一把深褐色小茶壶，中层放置一只白瓷茶杯，最高层仅放几片干岩茶叶；物体比例写实且互不重叠。

核心构图：“折页相连—山路层叠—茶烟贯通”。一缕琥珀色茶烟自壶嘴升起，沿着连接茶杯的折叠山路蜿蜒而行，宛如克制的写意水墨笔触，带有局部浓淡变化，但不构成具体文字或龙凤图案。主标题“山田入盏”以现代宋体在右侧留白处竖向排列，顶部小字“岚虚”，底部小字“岩茶”。配色方案：暖白、岩褐、茶汤琥珀色及极少量墨黑。

画面中不得出现人物、古装、真实茶室场景、满屏风景、大幅书法、金色边框、禅意陈词滥调、复杂包装或多图拼贴。
tags: 用于创建极简主义艺术风格的中国茶品牌商业海报的提示词，重点展

items.title: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer
items.titleZh: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

items.title: Ibaraki Travel Guide Cover
items.titleZh: A refined Japanese travel guide magazine cover illustration in a soft watercolor-and-ink editorial style, vertical A4 layout, airy pastel palette, elegant tourism-poster composition. The cover headline is dominated by very large serif blue text reading {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"}, with large Japanese title text below reading "茨城県 旅行ガイド" and a pale pink cursive English subtitle reading "Ibaraki Travel Guide". At the top left, include two lines of small Japanese copy about nature, history, scenery, and gourmet travel in Ibaraki, accented with a tiny pink cherry blossom icon. At the top right, place a large circular badge with fine dotted border containing Japanese text and the phrase "完全保存版" in the center with a small ribbon flourish underneath. The main subject is a young Japanese woman shown from the chest up, placed slightly right of center, facing left in three-quarter view. She has a chin-length wavy bob in deep dark brown to black, delicate loose strands, soft natural texture, and a calm neutral expression. She wears a light blue cardigan over a white ruffled blouse with a high gathered neckline, plus a thin beige shoulder bag strap. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain vertical rectangular gray censor block centered over the face area. Surround her with a collage of iconic Ibaraki scenery blended seamlessly into the cover art: a vast field of blue nemophila flowers across rolling hills in the upper right with a Ferris wheel in the distance and tiny visitors along the ridge; a traditional temple or pavilion among pink cherry blossoms at mid-right; a bright waterfall and landscaped stream at lower right; a torii gate standing in shallow ocean water at sunset in the lower left; and a mountain landscape near the bottom left center. Add abundant blue flowers in the foreground along the bottom edge and soft pink cherry blossoms framing the right side. Along the left side, include exactly 7 vertically stacked destination list entries in Japanese, each with a colored heading line and smaller descriptive subtext: "国営ひたち海浜公園", "偕楽園", "袋田の滝", "大洗磯前神社", "筑波山", "水郷・霞ヶ浦", and "グルメ・カフェ・おみやげ". At the lower left, place a blue circular badge with white Japanese text reading "モデルコース 4" and smaller itinerary copy below. At the lower right, include exactly 3 horizontal white label tabs with Japanese text and small icons: "絶景スポット", "ご当地グルメ", and "おみやげセレクション". Add a pink ribbon banner near the bottom right with small Japanese promotional text. Use a clean white background for the upper left, elegant magazine typography, delicate linework, dreamy spring atmosphere, polished tourism-cover design, high detail, premium print look.

items.title: Bubble Fox Friends Meet in Niseko
items.titleZh: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

items.titleZh: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}, with a white ribbon banner below that reads {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". items.title: Minimalist Literary Novel Cover
items.titleZh: A literary book cover in a refined minimalist editorial style, vertically oriented, with a muted palette of deep black, dark green, sepia, and warm cream. The composition is divided by large flowing curtain-like abstract shapes that create dramatic negative space and diagonal wedges of light. On the right side, show an elderly butler-like man seen from behind, standing upright in a formal black tailcoat or tuxedo jacket, white shirt cuffs visible, hands clasped behind his back, facing a tall softly glowing window with sheer curtains. His posture is reserved, dignified, and solitary. On the lower portion, within a triangular beam of light, place a dim still life on a table: exactly 3 objects, a wine glass, a teapot, and a plate, all partially obscured in shadow. The left side should carry elegant vertical Chinese title typography reading {argument name="title text" default="长日将尽"}, set large in pale gold serif-like characters. Beneath it, include smaller Chinese author and translator lines, and a short Chinese quote in small text. Near the lower left, add small English text reading {argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} and {argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"}, plus a small publisher line and the year {argument name="year" default="2024"}. The image should feel like an award-winning contemporary literary fiction cover: quiet, melancholic, restrained, cinematic, with paper grain texture, soft vignette, subtle painterly shading, and highly intentional asymmetrical layout. Keep the typography integrated into the design, with generous negative space and no bright colors.

items.titleZh: A bold Japanese advertising poster on an off-white textured paper background with a slightly worn print grain. Create a full-body fashion-style photo of a young woman standing slightly right of center in a wide, confident stance, legs apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing forward. Her face is intentionally blurred for anonymity. She has long straight split-dyed hair, one half {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} and the other half {argument name="second hair color" default="pastel blue"}, falling past her chest. She wears a white oversized T-shirt with the black chest print {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and chunky white sneakers. Use clean studio lighting with soft shadows under her feet. Fill the left half of the poster with huge distressed black Japanese typography in an energetic diagonal layout reading {argument name="main headline" default="センスない奴は画像とテキストを極めろ"}, with oversized characters stacked and overlapping for maximum impact. Add 2 broad paint-brush swashes behind the lower headline area: 1 pink brush stroke sweeping from the lower left toward center and 1 blue brush stroke sweeping from center-right toward the far right. In the upper right, place a compact vertical block of small black Japanese copy in 4 lines reading: 「AI動画の自動化に 溺れるな。 静止した一枚と、 研ぎ澄まされた言葉が、 最も強い武器になる。」 arranged like a manifesto note. In the lower right, add a small angled English text block in uppercase reading {argument name="tagline text" default="MASTER TEXT & IMAGE. SHAPE PERCEPTION. CONTROL THE OUTCOME."}. In the lower left corner, add a small brand signature reading "OKIHIRO AI CREATIVE MANIFESTO". The overall composition should feel like a modern creative manifesto poster, mixing fashion editorial photography, Japanese street advertising, bold typography, and minimalist graphic design.

items.title: Old Shanghai Fusion Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical cultural travel poster on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handcrafted 3D shadow-box collage that forms the silhouette of the Chinese character for Shanghai. Use a refined old-meets-new Shanghai theme with miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed straight-on with soft studio lighting and delicate drop shadows. The composition should feel elegant, editorial, nostalgic, and premium, with muted cream, brass gold, teal green, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. At the upper left, build the top section of the character from 1 modern glass skyscraper, 1 tall historic high-rise with a golden crown, 1 domed neoclassical waterfront building, 1 clock-tower civic building, 2 smaller background towers, 2 red vintage Shanghai trams, and 1 rickshaw. Beneath that, create a canal-town section with 2 tall red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres-and-columns motifs, 2 qipao dresses displayed vertically, 4 old shikumen and lane houses, 1 curved waterfront canal, 4 wooden boats on the water, and 2 gramophones placed at the far left and right edges. Across the center, place a large diagonal metallic-gold embossed title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} in bold retro 3D lettering. To the right of the upper composition, add hand-lettered vintage script text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}. On the lower left, add serif text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}. The lower half should form the rest of the character using traditional Chinese architectural miniatures and market objects: 1 large classical Chinese roofed building complex, 4 vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, 2 square decorative plaques, 1 small green ceramic ewer, 2 shallow food trays, 1 rectangular tray of 6 soup dumplings, 1 long tray with 3 white tanghulu-like skewered sweets, 2 round mooncakes, and 1 small sauce dish, 1 rectangular display shelf containing 4 steamed buns, 1 bowl of noodles, 2 golden pastries, 1 plate of white flower-shaped sweets, 1 small doll figurine, and 2 painted opera masks, plus 2 hanging newspapers at the lower right. Keep the background spacious and minimal, with the collage and text arranged diagonally for a sophisticated poster layout. Make the whole image look like a meticulously assembled handmade paper-and-wood diorama, combining Art Deco Shanghai glamour, Republican-era nostalgia, Jiangnan water-town charm, and traditional Chinese market culture.

items.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster
items.titleZh: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

items.title: Anime Folding Bike Event Poster
items.titleZh:
A bright, cheerful anime-style promotional poster for a folding bike cycling event, designed like a polished Japanese advertisement with dense typography, stickers, callouts, and event info panels. The scene shows a sunny riverside promenade under a vivid blue sky with fluffy clouds, green tree branches framing the top right, flower beds, bunting, drifting petals, and a distant modern city skyline across the water. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

Fill the poster with Japanese ad-style layout elements. At the top left, a huge multicolored headline reads "Let’s FOLDING RIDE!" in oversized playful bubble and block lettering, with a smaller curved Japanese line above it reading "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！" and a blue ribbon-like subtitle below reading "フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！". At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". items.title: French New Wave Torn Poster Collage
items.titleZh: A vintage 1960s French New Wave cinema poster collage on aged beige paper, designed like a torn-paper art-house one-sheet with analog grain, distressed print texture, rough ripped edges, ink wear, halftone imperfections, and slight misregistration. Center the composition around a large black-and-white portrait of a woman with messy dark hair, hand raised to her face, holding a cigarette, cropped from the chest up, with her face obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a layered collage layout with exactly 8 major paper elements: 1) a top-left black text block reading "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent" above the large stacked name "ANNA KARINA" and smaller text "dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD"; 2) a red torn quote panel on the left reading "Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD"; 3) a blue torn panel in the upper right with a black label reading "PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962"; 4) a narrow torn newspaper clipping on the upper right reading "l’amour est plus fort que la mort"; 5) a yellow torn panel on the mid-right showing a black silhouette of a man in a hat facing a woman, beside a vertical black filmstrip border with white sprocket holes; 6) a bottom-left black-and-white Paris street photo with wet pavement, a lamppost, pedestrians, and a visible sign reading "HOTEL DU NORD"; 7) a small bottom-left review text block reading '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'; 8) a bottom-right cropped black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block, partially covered by a red torn paper shape. Across the lower middle, place the huge torn-paper title in bold condensed uppercase: "À BOUT DE" in black and "SOUFFLE" in red, slightly angled and spanning most of the width. Under the title, add a blue torn strip with white uppercase text "UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ". At the bottom center, add "COMING SOON" in black uppercase and below it "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR". Limit the palette to faded cream, black, deep ultramarine blue, muted poster red, and mustard yellow. The overall mood is rebellious, romantic, and cinematic, like an iconic French New Wave poster made from ripped magazines, street photography, and bold typography.

items.title: French New Wave Protest Film Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.

Use a bold limited palette of deep black, warm cream, saturated poster red, and mustard yellow. The composition is a single unified poster with a large cropped portrait of {argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"} on the left half, shown from chest up, wearing dark sunglasses, a dark shirt, a chain necklace, and a mustard yellow jacket, with short dark hair styled up; the face is intentionally obscured by a centered rectangular block in muted taupe-gray, creating an editorial anonymized look. Near the right side, add a handwritten white script note with exactly 3 lines: “Visual Storyteller”, “Brand Builder”, and “AI Explore”. In the lower area, arrange exactly 6 creative-tech objects: 1 circular orange graphic icon, 1 white audio waveform/equalizer graphic, 1 black film clapperboard labeled with “AI”, 1 open silver laptop, 1 pair of black headphones, and 1 large professional cinema camera body with visible “RED” marking; also include the edge of a music keyboard/controller at the bottom right. In the bottom-right corner, place a small dark terminal-style text block with tiny white monospace lines suggesting AI-generated visuals and analytics. items.title: Japanese Apartment Horror Game Screenshot
items.titleZh: A realistic first-person horror game screenshot set in a narrow, dimly lit Japanese apartment corridor at night, viewed from slightly behind a lone human figure standing in the hallway. The figure is a young woman with straight dark shoulder-length hair, seen mostly in silhouette from the back, wearing a dark hoodie and a backpack, facing forward toward the end of the corridor. The setting is an older concrete apartment building interior with glossy reflective floor tiles, stained off-white walls, multiple apartment doors on both sides, and a cold fluorescent ceiling light receding into the distance. One apartment door on the right side is slightly open, emitting a vivid supernatural purple glow that spills into the hallway and creates rippling light patterns across the wall and floor. On the left foreground, include 2 beverage vending machines with illuminated rows of drinks. Also on the left wall, place a black sign with large Japanese text reading "事故物件", smaller text beneath, and a visible QR code. On the right wall, include a bulletin board and 4 posted notices: a warning-style poster with large red Japanese text, a dense text notice, a moving-service flyer with bold red text and phone numbers, and a vertical anti-crime sign. At the lower right, place a small magazine rack or stand holding several pamphlets, with the front magazine showing Japanese text including "月刊オカルト". Through the far end of the corridor, show a balcony railing and distant city lights. Add an in-game HUD overlay to make it look like a captured indie horror game screen: top left mission text in Japanese with 2 lines, including a green progress counter "2/5"; top right a digital time display "23:47" and date "2024/04/11"; bottom left a camcorder interface with Japanese text, a red recording dot, "4K", and "60FPS"; bottom right green Japanese collection text and a row of 4 inventory slots with only 2 occupied icons. Cinematic composition, moody shadows, photorealistic textures, subtle film grain, surveillance-camera and found-footage atmosphere, ominous supernatural tension, purple and blue-black color palette, realistic Japanese typography, ultra-detailed indie survival horror aesthetic.

items.titleZh: Create a premium cinematic food advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="PRASUMA"} frozen momos in a dark moody studio setting. The composition is a square social-media-ready commercial poster with luxurious high-contrast lighting, shallow depth of field, and rich food-photography styling. In the foreground, place a rustic off-white speckled ceramic plate holding exactly 4 steamed momos, arranged naturally; 3 are whole and 1 is cut open to reveal a detailed juicy minced filling. The dumplings should look glossy, freshly steamed, delicately pleated, and lightly garnished with chopped green herbs and seasoning. Add visible wisps of steam rising from the plate and from a single momo being lifted in the upper right by a pair of dark wooden chopsticks. items.title: Absurd Tabloid Panther Newspaper Front Page
items.titleZh:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.

items.title: Autumn in New York Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical editorial-style travel poster in Spanish for a {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"} titled “OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK,” designed with a sophisticated urban autumn mood and a premium photography-workshop aesthetic. Use a tall mobile-friendly poster layout with a warm off-white, beige, charcoal, and burnt orange palette. The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel advertisement, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, gritty New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.

items.title: Chaotic Fourth Crusade Parody Poster
items.titleZh: A chaotic fictional Japanese movie poster themed around world history, designed like a glossy blockbuster comedy-action epic about the Fourth Crusade getting completely lost and attacking Constantinople instead of reaching Jerusalem. The composition is dense, loud, and satirical, with a dramatic historical battlefield collage under a bright blue sky, flames, smoke, medieval ships, domes, city walls, and crusader armies. In the center foreground, a full-body medieval crusader in a dirty white tunic with a large red cross points directly toward the viewer, surrounded by four other medieval figures in ornate robes, hoods, helmets, and merchant-like clothing; their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs, making the poster look like a parody cast reveal. Across the top, huge hot-pink Japanese brush lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}, with smaller black Japanese tagline text above and below it. A torn vertical caption on the left side in bold yellow Japanese text explains that they meant to head for Jerusalem but somehow crush the Byzantine Empire. Two large parchment banners cross the upper middle area: one says that the original destination was Jerusalem, and the larger center banner declares in bold red Japanese text that the destination is Jerusalem, followed by smaller black text saying that was supposed to be the plan. On the upper right, a pinned parchment itinerary board contains a 5-step comedic route list with icons and arrows: departure, no money, bowing to Venice, lightly attacking Zara, then Constantinople, ending with a red line implying they somehow arrived there. Around the characters are exactly 8 speech balloons and callout labels: one saying “Eh, huh?”, one saying “No money…”, one saying “By order, let’s go.”, one saying “Slight detour.”, one saying “I failed, lol.”, one saying “Zara? We passed there!”, one label for a “contract” with a note that it is kind of expensive, and one pointing to Venice as a sponsor-like label. Additional wooden or parchment location signs label exactly 3 places: Zara, Venice, and Constantinople, with Japanese side notes identifying them as Christian or Byzantine cities. The lower half becomes darker and more catastrophic, showing a burning Byzantine-style city with a large domed church resembling Hagia Sophia, naval combat, collapsing architecture, orange firelight, and black smoke. At the bottom center, enormous distressed Japanese title typography in yellow and white announces the film as the Fourth Crusade and says Constantinople burns due to getting lost, with gritty texture, heavy drop shadows, and explosive blockbuster poster styling. On the right side of the title area, a red stamped burst says in Japanese that it begins around 1204. Along the very bottom is a narrow cast strip with exactly 6 small cast thumbnails labeled in Japanese, plus tiny fake credits running across the footer. In the bottom right corner, place a bright pink starburst badge with yellow and white Japanese text reading {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}. Overall style: absurd historical parody, cinematic key art, Japanese theatrical poster, high detail, photobashed realism mixed with exaggerated graphic design, weathered paper textures, bold manga-like captions, comedic educational tone, epic war-movie energy.

items.titleZh: A moody editorial street-fashion poster shot in a narrow urban alley, featuring a young woman in a dark navy oversized tracksuit with white double side stripes, sitting crouched on the sidewalk and leaning against a black metal roll-up shutter beside a sticker-covered utility pole. She has dark hair tied in a messy top bun with loose bangs, and wears chunky black, white, and gray sneakers. The pose is relaxed and introspective, with both knees drawn up and the body turned slightly left. Use soft natural late-afternoon sunlight coming from the right, creating warm highlights and long shadows, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the alley background. items.title: Retro Fake Anime Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A retro Japanese movie poster for a fictional anime film, designed like an overdramatic 1980s to 1990s theatrical poster with intentionally tacky but charming pulp energy. The scene shows a teenage girl manga artist in a dim wooden Japanese room at night, seated on the floor beside a low desk covered with scattered manuscript pages, pens, ink, books, and drawing tools. She has messy dark shoulder-length hair blown by supernatural force, a cream-beige long-sleeve blouse with loose ruffles, and a dark plaid skirt. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She stretches one arm upward, holding a glowing {argument name="device type" default="smartphone"} toward a shattered window as a blinding explosion of light and lightning bursts through the glass, illuminating the whole room with gold-white energy. Outside the window is deep blue night with stormlike streaks and electric cracks. The composition is dynamic and diagonal, with the raised arm and device pointing into the central blast. Use painterly anime key art styling, dramatic rim light, textured film-poster shading, rich teal, navy, amber, and crimson colors, and a nostalgic hand-painted cinema-poster feel. Fill the poster with bold Japanese promotional copy in multiple blocks on the left side, including exaggerated red and yellow emphasis marks and three small cartoon reaction faces of a classic manga boy character. Add a vertical Japanese tagline on the right side. Place an enormous stylized Japanese title across the lower middle in red and blue metallic gradient lettering with sharp highlights and heavy shadow, reading {argument name="title text" default="トキヲ描ける少女"}. Include a cream starburst badge near the lower right with more Japanese text and a small manga face. items.titleZh: A glossy, feminine scrapbook-style office announcement poster inspired by a sitcom workplace promo, in a vertical 2:3 composition. The scene shows 1 central woman standing in front of a group of 7 office coworkers inside a warm beige office with venetian blinds, desks, and a visible Dunder Mifflin-style wall sign in the background. The central woman has blonde hair in a messy high bun, a light pink floral V-neck dress, folded arms, and a confident, celebratory pose. Behind her, the 7 coworkers are arranged in a loose semicircle, wearing office attire in muted blues, browns, black, and lavender. Build the image as a mixed-media collage with torn paper, taped notes, brush-lettered headlines, glitter textures, flowers, and pink-and-gold accents. At the top left, place a pink rectangular company card with a white office icon and the text “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC” and “PAPER COMPANY”. Across the upper center, place a large torn-paper headline reading “TRANSFER CONFIRMED” in expressive brush lettering, with “TRANSFER” in hot pink and “CONFIRMED” in black, plus pink underline strokes and a hand-drawn heart. At the top right, pin a small off-white note card with a pink pushpin and pink tape reading “NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON.” Near the lower center, layer a bold title made of 4 stacked text strips: “{argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}” on a pink paint-stroke banner, “IS” on a small white strip with 2 tiny hearts, “JOINING” on a gold brush-stroke banner, and “THE OFFICE” on a pale pink strip. On the lower left, hang a tall pink transfer tag clipped with a gold paperclip, reading “FROM DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC PAPER COMPANY / SCRANTON, PA / EST. 1949” and below that “TO THE OFFICE / SCRANTON, PA”, with a pink women-and-desk restroom-style icon at the bottom. On the lower right, place a pink note card with 3 labeled sections: “NEW ROLE” with “{argument name="job title" default="Sales Representative"}”, “NEW TEAM” with “{argument name="team text" default="Same Paper"}”, and “NEW MEMORIES” with “{argument name="memories text" default="Let’s make some!"}”, each accented with small pink hearts. Along the bottom center, add a pink ribbon strip reading “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}♡”. Beneath that, include 3 small icon-and-text items in one row: sparkle icon with “NEW JOB”, group icon with “NEW TEAM”, and heart icon with “NEW MEMORIES”. At the bottom right, add large handwritten pink script saying “LET’S GO!”. Decorate the corners with pink peonies, tiny white filler flowers, torn paper edges, soft glitter dust, and subtle gold foil flecks. Use a warm rosy palette with blush pink, cream, gold, and black, with polished poster compositing, soft glam lighting, and a cheerful celebratory mood.

items.titleZh: Square Japanese dark electro pop album cover, cinematic and ethereal, set at night in a rainy empty urban alley with wet reflective pavement and deep blue-black shadows. Center a ghostly elegant woman standing directly in front of a glowing vending machine filled with visible drink cans, the machine casting icy blue-white light around her while small red indicator lights glow on the right side. She has extremely long flowing silver-lavender hair, pale skin, and an enigmatic faceless or obscured-face treatment with the face hidden in shadow or a smooth blurred void. She wears an off-shoulder translucent {argument name="dress style" default="shimmering gray tulle gown"} with delicate sparkle texture, sheer draped sleeves, and ornate crystal jewelry at the neck and chest. Her pose is solemn and prayer-like, one hand raised holding a coin near her lips, the other hand gently clasping her wrist. Add 2 glowing red stigmata-like cross marks, one on the wrist and one on the hand, emitting subtle light. The mood is melancholic, mystical, futuristic, sacred, and slightly gothic. Use a high-contrast palette of cold neon blue, silver, black, and crimson accents, with mist, drizzle, soft bloom, fine film grain, and dramatic backlighting from the vending machine. Integrate ornate vintage border decorations in all 4 corners and a thin frame line around the cover. At the top center, place the artist name {argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"} in elegant serif capitals with a smaller Japanese line beneath: {argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"}. items.title: Filmmaking Eras Typographic Grid
items.titleZh:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.

items.title: Vintage Little Prince Space Postcard
items.titleZh: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.

items.title: Japanese Fashion Cover with Koinobori Dresses
items.titleZh: A fashion magazine cover styled like a luxurious Japanese women's magazine, photographed in soft natural daylight against a pale blue sky with a faint city skyline blurred in the background. The masthead is huge and elegant across the top, reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} in oversized soft pink serif lettering, with small Japanese cover text above and around it, plus a small issue marker on the upper right reading "5", "May 2026", and "No.218". Center the cover on exactly 2 young adult Japanese women standing close together from about thigh-up, facing camera in a poised editorial pose, with their faces intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by koinobori carp streamers: high Mandarin-style collar, sleeveless inner dress, long sheer cape panels draping from the shoulders, elaborate layered metallic and satin fish-scale appliqué across the bodice, a large stylized fish eye motif on the chest, more scale detailing and fin-shaped ornamentation at the hip, and a cinched waist with decorative jeweled clasp. Her dark hair is in an elegant updo with loose wisps, and she wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears the same design concept in pale pink and white, also with a high collar, translucent cape-like side panels, layered fish-scale bodice, a visible fish eye motif near the waist sash, soft pleated skirt, tassel ornament at the belt, and matching dangling earrings; her dark hair is also swept into a refined updo with a few loose strands. The overall styling is airy, graceful, feminine, and sophisticated, mixing traditional Japanese elegance with modern couture. Use a pastel palette dominated by baby blue, blush pink, white, and subtle gold trim, with bright but diffused lighting and a premium glossy magazine editorial finish. Include visible Japanese cover lines arranged like a real magazine layout: one left-side block introducing the cover girls, one large main headline block across the lower half, one right-side vertical cluster of smaller teaser text, and exactly 2 pale blue circular callout badges on the right side containing Japanese text; the upper badge advertises a special appendix gift set and includes exactly 2 small product images of pouch-like accessories, and the lower badge contains a shopping-plan checklist with exactly 3 checkbox lines. Add a small pink ribbon-like label above the main headline. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and seasonally themed around Golden Week and koinobori fashion.

At the top center, big glossy dimensional typography reads "Disney•PIXAR" above the main title "The AI Web Design Sprint" in huge bold white 3D letters. Directly underneath, smaller bright text reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the center foreground, 2 adult men sit side by side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, casual startup-founder vibe, one in a dark hoodie and one in a light sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing camera in a friendly promotional pose. Their faces should be generic and unobtrusive, with the emphasis on the event-poster composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has 3 visible stickers: a purple code-brackets sticker, a black sticker with a white burst symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker reading "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." Around the scene, include 4 whimsical animated mascot elements: a small hovering robot drone lamp in the upper left with glowing blue eyes and a cone of warm light shining downward; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right; a tiny red pixel character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-like digital mascot standing on the table in front of the laptop. On the right side, a vertical monitor displays a dark coding interface with readable text including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a checklist titled "Sprint Plan" with 4 items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", "SHIP". On the left side, a hand-lettered paper signboard contains 4 notices pinned together: "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", and "$10 ADV / $12 DOS". In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL" with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta plant pot with green leaves reads "CREATIVE COLLISION". At the bottom center, large bold text reads "APRIL 27–30" and below it "LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB." Add a tiny line of faux credits along the bottom edge in classic movie-poster style, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, and a playful production credit. Use dramatic warm-orange and cool-blue lighting, polished animated-film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, highly detailed poster design, charming tech startup energy, and a premium event-advertisement finish.

The composition is asymmetrical and editorial, with a strong grid and generous negative space. In the top left, place a small red uppercase line of text reading {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}, followed by a thin horizontal black rule stretching toward the right. Below it, set an oversized stacked headline in ultra-bold black sans serif, left aligned, reading {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}, broken across 4 lines with dramatic scale so the words dominate the left half of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, add 1 large solid red rectangle as a graphic block. Beneath that red block, place a compact black uppercase subhead in 3 lines: {argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}. In the lower middle, include 2 cropped grayscale portrait photos of men from the chest up, side by side, documentary style, slightly overlapping the typography area; the left man has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, the right man wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and has facial hair. Obscure both faces with 2 vertical soft-edged gray censor rectangles centered over each face. Along the right side, create a vertical feature column with 4 black square icons, each separated by thin horizontal divider lines and paired with uppercase labels. The 4 items are: a starburst icon with the label "CREATIVE COLLISION", a connected-nodes icon with the label "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS", a code brackets icon with the label "CODE IN MOTION", and a terminal prompt icon with the label "REAL-TIME DESIGN". Near the bottom, add a full-width footer separated by a thin horizontal black rule. Inside the footer, create 4 text blocks divided by slim vertical lines: block 1 says "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. items.title: Premium Beverage Commercial Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a bold, high-end commercial poster for a premium {argument name="product" default="orange juice"} brand, shot in a hyper-realistic studio environment with a strong emphasis on freshness, precision, and striking visual appeal.
Hero Composition:
A sleek transparent bottle filled with rich, vibrant {argument name="liquid" default="orange juice"} stands at the center. The label is minimal, modern, and premium, featuring a clean orange graphic with refined typography. The bottle is topped with a matte black cap, enhanced by subtle highlights and realistic reflections.
Action & Story:
Two hands wearing matte black gloves interact with the product:
One hand firmly grips the bottle from the top
The other slices through a thick, juicy orange using a sharp stainless steel knife
The cut is captured mid-action, showcasing the juicy pulp and fresh citrus texture. A few orange slices are placed at the base, slightly scattered to create a natural yet styled composition.
Lighting & Mood:
Background: deep, rich green gradient with cinematic falloff
Surface: dark matte table with soft, controlled reflections
Lighting: dramatic studio setup
Strong key light from one side for depth
Soft fill light for balance
Crisp highlights on the bottle and knife
Deep, clean shadows for contrast
Typography Layout:

Top corner:
Clean, modern brand name (e.g., “VITRA”, “FRESCO”, or “NATURO”) in white
Bottom section:
Small line: “Not your average juice”

Large bold headline: “{argument name="headline" default="PURE ORANGE. NO COMPROMISE."}”
Typography should feel modern, bold, and premium with a strong visual hierarchy. Use a rich orange tone for the headline to complement the juice.

Visual Style:

High-end food advertising aesthetic

Cinematic, bold, and contrast-driven

Ultra-sharp details and textures

Premium editorial look (like a global campaign)

Clean yet powerful composition

Output Requirements:

4K resolution

Photorealistic, advertisement-grade quality

Sharp focus, rich contrast, high dynamic range

items.title: Weathered Custom Cub Concept Bike
items.titleZh: A highly detailed concept illustration of a customized vintage step-through motorcycle inspired by a Honda Super Cub, shown in a clean studio-like three-quarter left side view on a plain light gray background. The bike has a rugged post-apocalyptic street-build aesthetic with a black, white, and muted gray color scheme accented by small pink stickers and decals. Emphasize heavy weathering: chipped paint, scratches, oil stains, grime, rust flecks, ink splatter, worn edges, and layered sticker residue across the entire body. The front has 1 square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and 2 smaller stacked auxiliary lights beneath it. Use spoked wheels, thick all-terrain tires, visible front suspension, exposed mechanical detail, chain drive, and a sturdy center stand touching the ground. The leg shield and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese-style warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed typography, including a bold large kanji mark on the front fairing. Add 2 hard side cargo boxes on the rear, one larger box on the far side and 1 nearer black box with extra stickers, plus 1 hanging vertical tag charm attached near the rear case. Include 1 long black ribbed seat, rear rack framing, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact utility accessories that make it feel hand-modified and functional. Render it like an industrial design sketch mixed with polished anime mech concept art: precise linework, watercolor wash shadows, soft gray ground shadow, high-detail mechanical realism, slightly messy inked edges, and a collectible custom-bike illustration feel.

items.title: Luxury Germany Travel Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Germany"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.

items.title: Luxury Magazine Cover With Featured Book
items.titleZh: A photorealistic premium magazine cover in the style of an international design and business publication, shot as a sophisticated editorial still life. The cover features a dark, moody interior with shallow depth of field and warm ambient lighting. Center-right, standing upright on a glossy black marble table, is a cream-colored paperback book titled {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} by {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}. The book is angled slightly to the left so both the front cover and spine are visible. The cover illustration is minimalist navy-blue line art showing an office interior with an open door leading into a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water cooler, a desk with stacked papers, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author’s name appears near the lower left of the front cover, and the title also runs vertically on the spine. To the left of the book on the marble surface is a small stack of 4 books, softly out of focus, and in the lower-left foreground sits 1 dark coffee cup on a saucer. Behind them is a dim, elegant room with blurred shelving and a soft green plant shape in the background. The magazine masthead dominates the top: {argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} in very large white serif letters across the width, with small white issue text at top left reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} and small white tagline text at top right reading “THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”. Beneath the masthead is a thin rule and a category line in small gold serif text with 6 categories separated by dots: “AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”. On the left side, large white serif cover headline text reads “Rethinking Success”. Below it is a white serif subheadline about leaving the default path behind and building a life and work that matters, followed by a small gold page number. Further down the left column are 4 editorial teaser blocks, each with a gold circular icon and gold uppercase heading, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. The 4 headings are “ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”, “WORK WITH PURPOSE”, “A NEW STORY”, and a boxed teaser “DESIGN SPECIAL”. At the bottom right is a realistic barcode block with small pricing text above it and a small issue number beside it. The overall layout should feel like a real luxury magazine cover mockup: crisp typography, elegant serif fonts, black, white, cream, and gold palette, glossy reflections on the marble, cinematic shadows, subtle product reflection beneath the book, and high-end editorial photography styling.

items.title: Funny DIY Disaster Cat Comic
items.titleZh: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. items.title: Elegant Chinese Calendar App UI
items.titleZh: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for {argument name="month" default="4月"} with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for {argument name="year" default="2026"}, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

items.title: Retro Mince and Tatties Action Poster
items.titleZh: A bold retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of red, black, and warm cream on a lightly aged paper texture. The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.

items.title: Anime Fashion Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: A stylized Japanese fashion magazine cover titled MODE TOKYO, designed like a glossy contemporary women's style publication. The composition is a high-angle, dynamic street-fashion anime illustration of 2 girls looking up toward the viewer from beside a brick wall with colorful graffiti and dramatic sunlight. The girl on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in a lively messy ponytail with loose bangs, bright green eyes, a wide cheerful grin, and a sporty-feminine outfit: a light blue lace-trim camisole or slip-style top, short bottoms, chunky white sneakers, and a black choker. She is posed energetically, leaning forward with one knee bent, giving a confident summer-fashion editorial feel. The girl on the left has long vivid teal-green hair with straight heavy bangs, large blue eyes, and a calm, cool expression. She wears a casual layered street outfit in dark tones with a sleeveless top and sits lower in the frame, angled toward the right girl while gazing upward. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with crisp linework, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft skin shading, and a polished commercial illustration finish. The background should combine sunlit urban texture, blurred mural colors in pink, purple, orange, and black, and deep shadows to create contrast. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. Include dense magazine-cover typography in a premium editorial layout: a giant pink serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} across the top with TOKYO vertically on the left; on the upper right a dark circular or rounded block containing {argument name="issue number" default="06"}, JUNE 2024, vol.218, and cover lines in Japanese; on the left side several smaller Japanese and English fashion blurbs including NEO BASIC STYLE and SPORTY × FEMININE; a pink circular badge on the right with Japanese text and Trend 7; a large hot-pink Japanese headline across the lower left and center reading 私らしく、もっと輝く季節。; elegant white handwritten script diagonally across the lower right reading Shine in my Style; small footer cover lines and hashtags in Japanese; and a small BEAUTY label at bottom right. Make it look exactly like a real high-end Japanese fashion magazine cover, vertical format, full bleed, vibrant, youthful, feminine, sporty, and trendy.
